newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hongkong Bank buys new office in Beijing.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Bank buys new office in Beijing.

text.p: The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp Ltd, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, said on Monday it will buy 20,904 square feet of office space on two floors of COFCO Plaza in Beijing for US$7.8 million.
The bank said in a statement the purchased premise, including 9,053 square feet on the ground floor, would be the new site of its branch in the Chinese capital.
It said COFCO Plaza, one of Beijing's recently completed commercial developments, was situated in a prime location on Jianguomenwai Da Jie in the city's business centre.
Hongkong Bank obtained approval to establish a Beijing branch in July 1995.
In addition to Beijing, Hongkong Bank has five other branches in China in Qingdao, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Tianjin and Xiamen.
